items.title: Meta courts European bond investors in AI funding roadshow
items.title_zh: Meta在欧洲做非交易路演：为AI融资试探债券投资人
items.summary_zh: 彭博社9月11日报道，Meta已在欧洲与债券投资人接触至少一周，进行非交易路演，为超大规模云厂商的AI资本开支探路。知情人士称公司未给出具体发行时间；Meta从未在美元以外市场大规模发债，上次美元借款还在4月。

quotes.author: Bloomberg
quotes.en: Meta Platforms Inc. has been speaking to bond investors in Europe as part of a non-deal roadshow for at least a week as hyperscalers look to tap different global debt markets to fund the AI boom.
quotes.zh: Meta已在欧洲与债券投资人进行至少一周的非交易路演，超大规模云厂商正试图打开不同全球债务市场为AI热潮筹资。

items.title: Real-SWE: Benchmarking AI models on private, real-world, enterprise codebases
items.title_zh: Real-SWE：在私有真实企业代码库上评测AI
items.summary_zh: 新基准用私有企业代码库评测编程智能体，避开被刷分的公开题集。作者称自建类似流水线并不复杂；评论追问是否等于把私码交给OpenAI/Anthropic，并称约30%成功率与体感吻合。约260赞。

quotes.author: springtimesun
quotes.en:
I built exactly this using my own codebases. The setup isn’t that complex; split the git history to just before the change, sandbox the agent with everything they will need at that commit and lightly modify rules so they don’t go searching outside the box. Then they get the same prompt (usually the ticket that began the work) and are graded against the accepted PR.
The thing that takes the most time is finding the examples. In my real dev flow it’s rarely ticket -> PR ->…
quotes.zh: 我用自己的代码库做过一模一样的事。搭建没那么复杂：把git历史切到改动前，给智能体沙箱，带上那个commit需要的一切，再轻度……

quotes.author: prometheus1992
quotes.en: Does this mean they ended up sharing those private codebases with OAI, Anthropic etc? Also, the ~30% number tracks with my experience. I thought I was going insane for expecting too much from the models but they are still bad, including astra. This morning it messed something pretty trivial while fixing an issue which I was shocked to see. Also2, benchmarks don't mean much these days.
quotes.zh: 这是不是意味着他们最终把那些私有代码库分享给了OAI、Anthropic等？另外约30%这个数字和我的经验对得上。

items.title: EU tech chief Virkkunen calls for global AI rules after extinction warning
items.title_zh: 灭绝警告后，欧盟技术主管呼吁全球AI规则
items.summary_zh: 欧盟委员会执行副总裁Henna Virkkunen周五在都柏林表示，“全球规则确实必要”，回应前Anthropic工程师关于AI灭绝风险的病毒式警告。她强调欧盟AI法案要求评估失控风险，但全球并非如此；官员还在观察月底特朗普—习近平会晤如何触及AI军备叙事。

quotes.author: Henna Virkkunen / POLITICO
quotes.en: It's very important we continue now the international cooperation here, because I see that global rules are really needed.
quotes.zh: 继续推进国际合作非常重要，因为我认为全球规则确实必要。

items.title: Don't be the out of touch Kung Fu master
items.title_zh: 别当那个脱节的功夫大师：Carmack谈AI时代工程
items.summary_zh: 约翰·卡马克推文提醒工程师别做“脱节的功夫大师”。HN讨论从逐行心智转录转向架构与算法；也有人警告：热情写AI的人多半已有无AI基本功，后来者可能缺底座。约240赞、三百余评。

quotes.author: glimshe
quotes.en:
We are going from the era of manual, line-by-line mental model transcription to one where software engineers can focus on data structures, software architecture and algorithms.
I love being able to quickly bring out the program that is already running in my head without having to worry about the grind of typing it into a format that the compiler understands. Dealing with API names. Syntax. Language quirks. Library gotchas. A sizeable portion of my successful career as a…
quotes.zh: 我们正从逐行心智转录的时代，走向软件工程师能聚焦数据结构、软件架构与算法的时代。我爱能快速……

quotes.author: sriram_malhar
quotes.en: Everyone who writes enthusiastically about AI already has the benefit of having worked without AI. They have been schooled in the basics. Enough of us know about data structures, concurrency, networks, language design etc. from the ground up that the knowledge is passed on. I worry about the world that we will be living in when a whole generation has skipped learning the basics the hard way. Given the attendance rates at various educational institutions, I fear that day is…
quotes.zh: 每个热情写AI的人都已享受过没有AI时工作的好处。他们被基本功训练过。我们中够多人懂数据结构、并发、网络……

items.title: Iraq probes pipeline drones; Iran-backed militias deny role
items.title_zh: 伊拉克彻查管道无人机，伊朗支持民兵否认涉事
items.summary_zh: 沙特指无人机来自伊拉克后，巴格达紧急调查并谴责袭击；“伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗”等伊朗支持民兵伞兵组织否认参与。特朗普随后称伊朗“很可能”是幕后，同时试图安抚市场。管道关停使沙特经延布出红海的迂回出口再度受测。

quotes.author: AP / The Hill
quotes.en: Iraq's government raced to contain the fallout after Iran-backed militias were accused of attacking a key Saudi oil pipeline, shutting down the top global oil producer's alternative to the Iranian-threatened Strait of Hormuz.
quotes.zh: 在伊朗支持民兵被指袭击沙特关键输油管道、关停全球最大原油出口国相对霍尔木兹的替代通道后，伊拉克政府紧急控损。

items.title: Stabilizing Rust's Never Type
items.summary_zh: LWN报道Rust推进稳定`!`（never type），长期用`Infallible`打补丁的历史有望收官。评论称赞相对务实的向后兼容：接受罕见且可修的破坏，而不是要求百分之百零例外。约240赞。

quotes.author: Georgelemental
quotes.en:
> For many years, the standard library has had an `Infallible` type to work around the unstable nature of the never type. It served the same semantic purpose as the never type, but did not have any special compiler support. Therefore, code using it would be technically correct but suboptimal (such as having an extra layer of tags in an enumeration or emitting dead code), because the optimizer would not always be able to remove references to `Infallible`.
This is incorrect.…
quotes.zh: 多年来标准库用Infallible类型绕开never类型不稳定。它语义目的相同，但没有任何特殊……

quotes.author: srdjanr
quotes.en: I like the pragmatic approach to backwards compatibility (accepting relatively rare breakage that's not too hard to fix) instead of requiring 100% compatibility without exceptions
quotes.zh: 我喜欢这种务实的向后兼容：接受相对少见、也不难修的破坏，而不是要求毫无例外的100%兼容。

items.title: Houthi advance gives Iran 'veto power' narrative on Red Sea route
items.title_zh: 胡塞推进被伊朗媒写成红海航道“否决权”
items.summary_zh: 战争研究所9月11日更新指出：在美军协助下霍尔木兹南线油运回升至约日均千万桶之际，伊朗更难单靠本海峡阻断流量；胡塞逼近曼德海峡则为德黑兰提供另一施压工具。伊朗政权媒体称胡塞攻势赋予其沿关键航道的“否决权”——抬升保险、运力与军力成本而无需庞大舰队。

quotes.author: ISW
quotes.en: Houthi control over the Bab al Mandeb thus gives Iran an alternative way to pressure energy markets… Iranian regime media argued that the Houthi offensive gives the Houthis 'veto power' along a critical maritime route.
quotes.zh: 胡塞控制曼德海峡因而给伊朗提供了另一条施压能源市场的路径……伊朗政权媒体宣称胡塞攻势使其沿关键海上航道拥有“否决权”。

items.title: Android NAT-T keepalive offload bypasses VPN lockdown
items.title_zh: Android NAT-T保活卸载绕过VPN锁定
items.summary_zh: 论文揭示Android上NAT-T keepalive卸载可绕过VPN lockdown。评论讨论`Network.bindSocket`/SO_BINDTODEVICE权限模型，并批评用“累计安装量对比三十亿设备”淡化风险的说理方式。约200赞。

quotes.author: ValdikSS
quotes.en:
Android has a way to bind the socket to the interface: Network.bindSocket, this is a setsockopt(SO_BINDTODEVICE) wrapper with access control.
The access to it is controlled by the VPN application. Some applications could be allowed to connect directly when the VPN is active and routing all the traffic by default, some could use VPN if configured not to use it by default.
However starting with Linux kernel 5.7, the unprivileged userspace can now call…
quotes.zh: Android可以用Network.bindSocket把套接字绑到接口：这是带访问控制的setsockopt(SO_BINDTODEVICE)封装。访问由VPN应用控制。有时……

quotes.author: jeroenhd
quotes.en:
> FortiClient VPN and SmartVPN have 4,134,648 cumulative Google Play installs between them, while Google reports more than 3 billion active Android devices.
A very strange way to reason about killing an API instead of fixing the VPN issue (as someone from Google already suggested they're planning on doing). "Only 4 million people use this, we should kill it" is exactly the kind of reasoning Microsoft in the 2000s would use to kill the ability to install Linux on a PC.
quotes.zh: FortiClient VPN和SmartVPN在Play上累计安装约413万，而谷歌称有逾30亿活跃Android设备。用这种方式论证“杀掉……”非常奇怪。

items.title: IEA: Saudi crude supply at multi-decade lows amid Bab el-Mandeb attacks
items.title_zh: IEA：沙特原油供应跌至数十年来低位，曼德袭击是主因之一
items.summary_zh: IEA月报细节显示，8月全球观察到的石油库存再降9500万桶，自2月累计回吐约5.07亿桶；海湾产量较战前低逾千万桶/日。机构特别点出沙特原油供应跌至三十多年低位，部分因胡塞关联团体袭击途经曼德海峡的船只。缓冲库存收缩令冲突久拖的代价更透明。

quotes.author: IEA / Oil & Gas Journal
quotes.en: Saudi crude supply fell to the lowest levels in more than three decades, the International Energy Agency said on Friday, partly due to attacks on ships transiting Bab el-Mandeb by Houthi-linked groups.
quotes.zh: 国际能源署周五表示，沙特原油供应已跌至三十多年来最低水平，部分原因是胡塞关联团体袭击途经曼德海峡的船只。

items.title: P(doom)
items.title_zh: P(doom)：从概率修辞看末日叙事
items.summary_zh: Armin Ronacher随笔审视P(doom)话术如何塑造讨论。在Amodei呼吁放缓、讽刺文同步热传的同一时段，HN把“末日概率”从口号拆回可检验主张与激励结构。约150赞。

quotes.author: demibabs
quotes.en:
I’m not the biggest fan of Ed Zitron, but something he said that stuck with me is:
OpenAI and Anthropic spend much time warning us about “what if powerful AIs got into the wrong hands?”
But it’s already in the wrong hands.
quotes.zh: 我不是Ed Zitron的铁粉，但他有句话让我记住：OpenAI和Anthropic花大量时间警告“强大AI若落入坏人之手怎么办？”——可它已经在坏人之手里了。

quotes.author: pandoro
quotes.en: I cannot fathom how you can intensely work on a problem that you genuinely believe has a "10 to 25%" probability of causing immense harm or even present an extinction-level risk to humanity. How can you truly believe this and be ok with it?
quotes.zh: 我无法理解：你若真心相信自己正在猛攻的问题有“10%到25%”概率造成巨大伤害甚至人类灭绝级风险，怎么还能心安理得地继续干下去？
